meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 运行资源检测脚本，生成 .claude_resources.json 文件，记录 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘与操作系统信息，并给出并行、内存、GPU 加速等策略建议。不做压力测试，也不假定可见硬件都可用。
howto.when: 在计算密集型任务开始前触发，例如数据规模分析、模型训练、并行处理等场景；当用户要求按资源做规划时也会启用。

say.text: 先检测一下这台机器的CPU和内存情况再开始分析。
say.note: 会生成资源快照并给出建议。

say.text: 帮我看看有没有可用的GPU，该选哪个后端？
这个数据集有50GB，先检查资源再决定怎么处理。
say.note: 会根据内存和磁盘给出加载策略。

howto.what_en: Runs a resource detection script, produces .claude_resources.json with CPU, GPU, memory, disk and OS info, plus recommendations on parallel processing, memory strategy, GPU acceleration. No stress tests; doesn't assume visible hardware is usable.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of computationally intensive tasks, such as data analysis, model training, parallel processing, or when the user asks for resource-aware planning.

say_en.text: Check CPU and memory first, then start the analysis.
say_en.note: Generates a resource snapshot and suggestions.

say_en.text: Is there a GPU available? Which backend should I use?
say_en.note: Detects CUDA, ROCm, or Metal backends.

say_en.text: This dataset is 50GB; check resources before deciding how to process it.
say_en.note: Gives loading strategy based on memory and disk.
